title: ScopeToken
description: Opaque, stable identity for one scope pushed via InteractionManager.pushScope. Release exactly that scope - wherever it currently sits in the stack - through the matching InteractionManager.popScope call, regardless of whether other scopes were pushed (and are still active) above or below it. A token, not the scope's `root` node, is what identifies an entry: two scopes can legitimately share the same root (nesting a scope on a node that is already a scope root), and only a token distinguishes which of the two a given `popScope` call means to release.
